body.title: Through the plan walk, the removed route's absence, and the documents
body.summary: Add the test that runs the real adherence runtime through the plan walk: a check that fails for lack of constraints in the documents has its reason in the task's record and in tasksFailed, and the plan's report is still written from the other tasks. Add the source scan that no template, runtime or prompt of the analyze framework names constraintsSource (reading code and prompt text, not comments on history). Update docs/plans/docs-module.md where it describes how an adherence check gets its constraints (sections 3.5 and 8.5 and the lines on constraintIds), and add to docs/daemon.md a short section: the three ways and their order, the enumeration's record file, and the reasons a check can fail with.
acceptanceChecks: Run through the plan walk, a failed check's own reason is in its task record and in tasksFailed, and the plan's final report exists.
The source scan finds no use of constraintsSource in the templates, the runtimes or the prompts of the analyze framework.
docs/plans/docs-module.md no longer describes the upstream-task route as a way to give constraints, and docs/daemon.md has the new section.
The whole analyze suite passes with no failure that is not in the baseline; `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean.
